Travelers need to know that companion animal travel requires clear checks, calm handling, and close attention to welfare.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
This notice is for travelers who plan to carry a companion animal on Aurelia Skyways. Please bring the animal travel details to the desk early and keep all papers ready for review. Staff will guide you through the booking steps, explain the travel conditions, and confirm that the journey can be arranged without avoidable risk. The welfare coordinator will review comfort needs, including crate fit, water access, feeding plans, and any care notes that may affect the trip.

Every animal is handled by trained staff who give patient attention from check-in to departure. Travelers must present the animal in good condition, with secure equipment and the correct documents in hand. If the animal is unsettled, unwell, or not safely prepared, the desk may ask for further checks before travel can go ahead. This is done to protect the animal, the crew, and other passengers.

For routine support, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
